# Security Vulnerability Reporting

**Please DO NOT submit public issues for security vulnerabilities.**

To report a vulnerability securely:
- Use [GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/konethegreat/Vigil/security/advisories/new)
- Or email: **`erictshivhinda@gmail.com`**

See our full **[Security Policy](https://github.com/konethegreat/Vigil/blob/main/SECURITY.md)** for details on response timelines and PGP communication.
